messages:
rachel: Quick note — arcadia9b (int4) onboarding showed sporadic OOMs and a worse p95 during our long-context bench this morning, rolling the canary back.
 tom: ugh. any logs to paste?
 rachel: log snippet:
```
2026-04-18T08:11:02Z WARN  kv_cache: allocated +14 slots (400 -> 414)
2026-04-18T08:11:02Z ERROR oom: alloc failed attention_kv size=1098765432
2026-04-18T08:11:02Z INFO  request id=u7y gen_tokens=1400 route=arcadia9b-int4
```
 elio: 1400 tokens + prefetch_window=2 + batch_size=3 = classic slot-churn. int4 reduces bytes per tensor but makes the slot bookkeeping worse when prefetching.
 may: how do perf numbers look vs fp16?
 rachel: p50 ~140ms (similar), p95 went 480ms->980ms on long-gen load, throughput down ~28%. Quality (QA F1) within 0.2% overall but a small corpus of multi-turn code prompts showed token mismatches ~1.1%.
 nina: immediate mitigations we should push to canary route: reduce max_new_tokens default, lower prefetch, and enable soft_kv_evict/compactor cadence.
 tom: +1. proposed patch:
```
routes:
  - model: arcadia9b-int4
    defaults:
      max_new_tokens: 512
      batch_size: 2
      prefetch_window: 1
    runtime_flags:
      soft_evict: true
      kv_trim_threshold: 0.75
      compactor_interval_s: 300
```
 elio: also add a microbatch rule: if requested_gen_tokens >= 600 then cap batch_size to 1 for that request. prevents packing multiple long gens.
 may: routing fallback idea: for requests requesting >=1024 tokens, route to arcadia9b-int8 automatically. safe short-term fallback.
 rachel: diagnostics to capture in the smoke: nvml snapshots every 30s, jemalloc stats, slot-usage histogram, and `--mem-histogram` from the smoke runner. add `--nvml-snap --jemalloc --slot-hist --mem-hist` flags.
 devops-bot: deploybot: canary patch queued by tom — job #4776 started :hourglass_flowing_sand:
 tom: smoke plan: 60m canary with 250 randomized long-gen replays + 150 mixed conversations. Gates: no OOMs, p95 within 25% of fp16 baseline, quality delta <0.5% on eval set. nvml snapshots and slot-hist to artifacts.
 elio: if OOMs persist despite conservative defaults, fallback plan B: per-pod kv_max_slots cap and temporarily reduce compactor_interval_s to 120s. B2: route long requests to int8 as may suggested.
 nina: add a reactive safety rule: if free_slot_ratio < 0.2 disable prefetch for 60s cluster-wide for that pool. quick temporary shield.
 rachel: note on onboarding checklist: add "int4 long-context: require slot-hist, nvml snapshots, conservative defaults, microbatch rule, and an int8 fallback route". we'll update docs after canary.
 may: small quality thing — include 30 focused code-heavy multi-turn prompts in the smoke eval; rollback if token-mismatch > 2% for that set.
 tom: infra ask: confirm compactor runs on every node in the pool; in a previous run compactor missed a node and fragmentation spiked.
 devops-bot: deploybot: canary run #4776 in progress — posting artifacts to /artifacts/arcadia9b/4776.tar.gz when complete.
 elio: long-term engineering: we should investigate slot reuse heuristics and kernel allocation coalescing to reduce small alloc fragmentation. open R&D ticket after canary.
 rachel: thanks all — i'll hold rollback until job #4776 finishes and we'll review artifacts. auto-rollback: >2 OOMs in 45m or quality delta breach. will post results here. :thumbsup:
